body.title: Compose one progress runtime that accepts the review kinds
body.summary: Compose the one progress runtime so the review producers register next to the existing ones on the same coordinator and store; the composed validator (validateAllDetails) accepts every kind.
acceptanceChecks: one runtime accepts both review kinds plus the existing executor/workflow/analysis kinds through the composed validator
the review producers register on the same coordinator and store without disturbing existing kinds
